notes.title: Buy Tavern Master full version now!
notes.notes:
After working for a year and a half the full version of Tavern Master has been released! It contains much much more content than the Prologue version and I have paid special attention to making sure your Prologue save file works with the full version :)
Let me know your impressions of the full version in the comments!
